name: Google LLC
summary: American technology company best known for the Google search engine. Its products include Android, Chrome, Gmail, Google Maps, YouTube and Google Cloud. Google is a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc.
facts: Headquarters: Mountain View, California, United States
Industry: Internet, software, advertising, cloud computing

name: Alphabet Inc.
summary: Holding company created in 2015 to own Google and several other businesses. It is the parent company of Google LLC.
facts: Headquarters: Mountain View, California, United States

name: Microsoft Corporation
summary: American technology company that develops Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure cloud services and Xbox. It also owns LinkedIn and GitHub.
facts: Industry: Software, cloud computing, hardware, video games

name: Apple Inc.
summary: American technology company that designs the iPhone, Mac, iPad and Apple Watch, along with the iOS and macOS software and services such as the App Store.
facts: Founders: Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak, Ronald Wayne

name: Amazon.com, Inc.
summary: American company that runs one of the world's largest online stores and Amazon Web Services, a major cloud computing provider. It also makes Kindle devices and Prime Video.

name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
summary: American technology company that owns Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger. It changed its name from Facebook, Inc. to Meta in 2021.
facts: Headquarters: Menlo Park, California, United States

name: Tesla, Inc.
summary: American company that makes electric vehicles, battery storage and solar products.

name: Netflix, Inc.
summary: American streaming service and production company that offers films and series. It began as a DVD-by-mail rental business.
facts: Headquarters: Los Gatos, California, United States
Industry: Streaming, film and television production

name: YouTube
summary: Online video sharing platform where people upload, watch and share videos. It has been owned by Google since 2006.
facts: Founders: Chad Hurley, Steve Chen, Jawed Karim
Headquarters: San Bruno, California, United States

name: OpenAI
summary: American artificial intelligence research company best known for ChatGPT and the GPT family of language models.
facts: Headquarters: San Francisco, California, United States
Known for: ChatGPT, GPT models, DALL-E

name: Anthropic
summary: American artificial intelligence company focused on AI safety research. It develops the Claude family of AI models.
facts: Founders: Dario Amodei, Daniela Amodei and others
Headquarters: San Francisco, California, United States

name: NVIDIA Corporation
summary: American company that designs graphics processing units (GPUs). Its chips are widely used for gaming, data centers and artificial intelligence.
facts: Founders: Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky, Curtis Priem
Headquarters: Santa Clara, California, United States

name: Samsung Electronics
summary: South Korean electronics company and one of the world's largest makers of smartphones, televisions and memory chips. It is the flagship of the Samsung group.

name: Sony Group Corporation
summary: Japanese multinational that makes electronics, PlayStation consoles, and runs film, music and imaging businesses.

name: Nintendo
summary: Japanese video game company behind consoles such as the Switch and franchises including Mario, Zelda and Pokémon (published with partners). It began in 1889 making playing cards.

name: Toyota Motor Corporation
summary: Japanese car maker and one of the largest automobile manufacturers in the world.

name: Walmart Inc.
summary: American retail corporation that runs a large chain of supermarkets, discount stores and warehouse clubs.

name: The Coca-Cola Company
summary: American beverage company that makes Coca-Cola and a large range of other soft drinks, juices and waters sold worldwide.

name: McDonald's Corporation
summary: American fast-food company and one of the largest restaurant chains in the world, known for hamburgers and fries.

name: Nike, Inc.
summary: American company that designs and sells athletic shoes, clothing and equipment. It began as Blue Ribbon Sports.

name: The Walt Disney Company
summary: American entertainment company that owns film studios, theme parks and streaming services such as Disney+, along with Pixar, Marvel and Lucasfilm.
facts: Founders: Walt Disney, Roy O. Disney

name: Spotify
summary: Swedish audio streaming service offering music and podcasts.

name: North Korea
summary: Officially the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, a country in East Asia that covers the northern part of the Korean Peninsula. It is a one-party state led by the Workers' Party of Korea. The peninsula was divided into North and South after 1945.

name: South Korea
summary: Officially the Republic of Korea, a country in East Asia on the southern part of the Korean Peninsula. It has a large economy known for electronics, cars and popular culture.

name: United States
summary: A federal republic in North America made up of 50 states and the federal district of Washington, D.C. It is the world's largest economy.
facts: Language: English (de facto, no official language at federal level)

name: United Kingdom
summary: A country in northwestern Europe made up of England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

name: China
summary: Officially the People's Republic of China, the most populous country in East Asia and one of the largest countries in the world by area. It is governed by the Chinese Communist Party.

name: India
summary: A country in South Asia and the most populous democracy in the world. It is a federal parliamentary republic.

name: Japan
summary: An island country in East Asia, located in the Pacific Ocean. It has a constitutional monarchy with an emperor as a symbol of the state.

name: Russia
summary: The largest country in the world by area, spanning Eastern Europe and northern Asia.

name: Germany
summary: A country in central Europe with the largest economy in the European Union.

name: France
summary: A country in Western Europe with overseas regions and territories around the world. Its capital Paris is a global centre for art, fashion and culture.

name: Canada
summary: A country in North America that is the second largest in the world by total area.

name: Australia
summary: A country and continent in the Southern Hemisphere made up of mainland Australia, Tasmania and many smaller islands.

name: New Zealand
summary: An island country in the southwestern Pacific Ocean, made up of the North Island, the South Island and many smaller islands.
facts: Official languages: English, Māori, New Zealand Sign Language

name: Brazil
summary: The largest country in South America, home to most of the Amazon rainforest.

name: Mexico
summary: A country in North America known for its ancient civilisations, food and culture.

name: Italy
summary: A country in Southern Europe, home to Rome and much of the history of the Roman Empire and the Renaissance.

name: Spain
summary: A country in southwestern Europe on the Iberian Peninsula, with territories in the Atlantic and Mediterranean.

name: Iran
summary: A country in Western Asia, historically known as Persia.

name: Egypt
summary: A country in northeastern Africa, home to the ancient pyramids of Giza and the Nile River.

name: Nigeria
summary: The most populous country in Africa, located in West Africa.

name: South Africa
summary: A country at the southern tip of Africa with three capital cities and a wide mix of cultures and languages.
facts: Official languages: 12, including Zulu, Xhosa, Afrikaans and English

name: Indonesia
summary: A large island country in Southeast Asia with more than 17,000 islands.

name: Türkiye
summary: A country spanning southeastern Europe and western Asia, with Istanbul as its largest city.
